ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description first: The diagram shows rectangle ABCD with AD horizontal along the bottom, AB vertical on the right, BC horizontal on the top, and CD vertical on the left. Point H lies on BC with HB marked 6, point E lies on AD with DE marked 4, and the lines AH and EC extend leftward/upward to meet at G. Point F lies on the horizontal line AD extended to the left, and GF is drawn vertical, perpendicular to AF. Reasoning: Use the assigned coordinate setup. Let D=(0,0), A=(9,0), B=(9,8), and C=(0,8), since AB=8 and BC=AD=9. Since H is on BC and BH=6, H is 6 units left of B=(9,8), so H=(3,8). Since E is on AD and DE=4, E=(4,0). Line EC passes through E=(4,0) and C=(0,8), so its slope is (8-0)/(0-4)=-2 and its equation is y=-2x+8. Line AH passes through A=(9,0) and H=(3,8), so its slope is (8-0)/(3-9)=-4/3 and its equation is y=(-4/3)x+12. At their intersection G, -2x+8=(-4/3)x+12. Multiplying by 3 gives -6x+24=-4x+36, so -2x=12 and x=-6. Then y=-2(-6)+8=20, so G=(-6,20). Since GF is perpendicular to AF and AF lies on the horizontal AD line y=0, GF is the vertical distance from G to the x-axis, which is 20.
